evidence.section: Application of the Computational Model for an Industrial ESR Process
evidence.quote: An electrode of a nickel-iron-chromium superalloy was prepared by vacuum induction melting and subsequently electroslag remelted to a 1.12 m diameter ingot at Special Metals Corporation. The ESR process involved the use of an initial slag charge of 295 kg with a continual addition of slag in an attempt to maintain a relatively consistent slag cap layer throughout the duration of remelting. The composition of the slag employed was nominally 30 CaF2–28 CaO-7 MgO-28 Al2O3–7 TiO2 (wt%).
